_about: PROTECTED parameters. Each value is checked against the LIVE cdcx code by .ai/validate_handoff.py -- if the code and this file disagree, validation FAILS. Changing any of these requires explicit approval from the user, never just a handoff task.

atr_multiplier_overrides.meaning: Per-symbol stop multiplier (kept at 1.5 by user choice)

tp_ratios.meaning: TP1-TP4 as R-multiples of the stop distance

tp_close_pcts.meaning: % of original size closed at each TP

tp_mode.meaning: Take profits from ATR R-multiples (not structural)

max_risk_pct_gate.meaning: Final gate refuses any trade risking more

min_confluence_count.meaning: At least 2 of 1H/4H/1D/1W must agree (transitional TFs excluded)

confluence_timeframes.meaning: The only timeframes that count toward confluence

trading_mode.meaning: Real orders need TRADING_MODE=LIVE AND --live AND human YES

max_data_staleness_bars.meaning: Newest candle must be within 3 bars of now

circuit_max_consecutive_losses.meaning: Trading halts after 3 losses in a row

breakout_atr_multiple.meaning: A legitimate break must close past the level by 0.25 x ATR
